translated_title: Mexican Government Seeks Free Admission to 53 Museums and Archaeological Sites Next Year
original_title: Gobierno federal busca gratuidad en 53 museos y zonas arqueológicas para próximo año
author: Dora Villanueva
meta_description: Mexico's federal government proposes free admission to 53 INAH museums, monuments, and archaeological sites — among them Bonampak, La Venta, and Tamtoc — in next year's Federal Rights Law, saying the cost of charging is disproportionate to the revenue.
